rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for money left after costs or earned from selling goods and services.

example.english: The shop's profit is much higher this year than last year.
example.traditional: 間舖頭今年嘅利潤比上年高好多。
example.jyutping: gaan1 pou3 tau4 gam1 nin4 ge3 lei6 jeon6 bei2 soeng6 nin4 gou1 hou2 do1
